question: What do a spatially unstructured 3D exclusion fluid and two reversible conformational pathways do under constant chemical-potential environments and different transition-state pair interactions?
role: F: independently implemented microscopic lattice constitutive hypothesis; no identified-molecule, continuum, membrane or life claim

law.sites: periodic cubic lattice; at most one macromolecule per site, vacancy is implicit solvent; molecular spacing=1; kBT=1
law.states: I and B are conformations of the same conserved macromolecule; not distinct replicators
law.Hamiltonian: H=df*N_B + epsilon*N_BB; nearest-neighbor B-B pairs counted once
law.transition_state_meaning: epsilon_ts=ts_fraction*epsilon is a local contact energy of a second reaction saddle, independent of region labels. An additive common barrier may be absorbed into the time unit. It is an ASSUMED molecular energy, not a measured catalyst or an emergent property.
law.fuel: uniform chemostats F,W; mu=mu_F-mu_W fixed from t=0. Every net driven B->I consumes one F and returns one W; reverse events reverse that exchange. Reservoirs are placed external environments.
law.diffusion: one-site hop to empty nearest neighbor at D/(2*d)*exp(epsilon*nB_source) for B, D/(2*d) for I; reverse-hop ratio is exp(-DeltaH). Transition state has no B contacts. No overlaps or artificial permeability masks.
balances: H from independent full-lattice pair count
heat_to_bath=work-(H-H0); also accumulated event by event from log forward/reverse rates
limitations: implicit overdamped thermal solvent; particle momentum is not tracked
uniform ideal fuel reservoirs, no finite fuel transport
cubic lattice anisotropy and contact-energy coarse graining
microscopic chemistry and saddle contact energies are hypotheses, not fitted to real molecules

initial.occupied_sites: exactly round(density*N^d) independent uniformly sampled sites, without replacement
initial.B_fraction: floor(number_of_molecules/2) randomly located B conformers, remaining I
put_in: molecular lattice and finite periodic volume

known_control: With ts_fraction=0 the summed reaction ratio equals exp(epsilon*nB+df_eff), df_eff=df+log((1+eta*exp(mu/2))/(1+eta*exp(-mu/2))). Structure can be effective-equilibrium while fuel still cycles. This algebraic check is V, never a new discovery.

numerics.method: exact continuous-time Markov process via constant-bound null-event uniformization; local event acceptance and local neighbor updates only; no finite integration dt
numerics.scheduler_disclosure: global uniform proposal and auxiliary Poisson clock schedule local events; no global-state-dependent force, oracle, FFT or implicit solve. Does not claim physically simultaneous hardware execution.

validation_first: local detailed balance for every neighbor count and both pathways
independent full-lattice count and neighbor-cache agreement at every sample
finite-system Boltzmann distribution versus exact state enumeration at mu0, 3D first
one-particle random-walk statistics and unwrapped displacements
same-seed state determinism and output protection

verification.selection: follow up descriptive contrasts only after freezing all discovery outcomes; preregister specific matched controls before new runs
verification.volume_meaning: lattice spacing is molecular size: larger N means larger physical volume, not numerical resolution refinement
verification.dimension_2: diagnostic comparison only after 3D, never new-discovery substitute

readouts: all neighbor-count bins 0..2d, without selecting an interface in the dynamics
B/I/vacancy densities and reversible reaction counts separately by pathway and neighbor count
hop fluxes between all local-neighbor environments
periodic connected-region volumes, spans and topology limitations
coarse-density variance at fixed local averaging lengths 2 and 4 molecular cells
identity turnover and residence from persistent physical molecule IDs; observer labels never affect dynamics
true-3D diagnostics and all negative outcomes

instantaneous_local_environment_groups.dense: nB5..6; 3D only; all original bins retained

fixed_analysis.qualification: At least three DISTINCT physical observations require independent mechanism/alternative controls, discovery+holdout replication, time/volume evidence and a justified material-compartment relation. Known textbook/literature reproduction, direct read-back of rate/energy parameters and splitting one instability into several knobs do not count. No promise that three will be found.
fixed_analysis.formal_membrane_claim: not allowed without closed-interior, material mapping, selective transport and physical-resolution evidence; no ladder promotion by a density image

primary_source.relation: local exclusion, pair energy and thermodynamic constraints are related. Our 3D unseeded initial conditions and uncapped transition-state pair-energy rates are different. No source code copied; published known outcomes excluded from discovery count.

no_touch: previous campaign evidence and final status
